meaning: Presence and specification of policy responses in supplied, searched documents; not policy effectiveness, adequate ambition, implementation success or comprehensive portfolio quality

bands.label: No evidence found
bands.rule: No qualifying topic claim after complete processing of the defined usable-source scope; not national absence

bands.label: Context documented
bands.rule: Relevant concern, context, projection, reported effect or unadopted proposal, with no attributable policy response

bands.label: Policy response documented
bands.rule: At least one attributable commitment, planned action, implementation assertion or delivered output

bands.label: Delivery details documented
bands.rule: At least one coherent response with a named accountable or implementing organization, an anchored action timeframe, and a specific verifiable deliverable

actor.rule: Named responsible or implementing organization explicitly attached to this response; a funder or mentioned organization alone is insufficient

timeframe.rule: A stated delivery deadline, action period or dated milestone; publication year and contextual observation dates alone are insufficient

deliverable.rule: A specific verifiable quantity/output, identified asset, named legal instrument or identifiable milestone; generic 'rehabilitate canals' is insufficient

delivery_criteria.combination: All three criteria must be source-supported and explicitly attached to the same policy_object_id. Compatible evidence can come from different documents. A supports/contextualizes relation alone is insufficient.

claims.band_zero: Reserved for a complete topic search with no qualifying claims; never assigned to a sourced claim
claims.variant_rule: Assess each coherent variant independently. All variants of a claim share one policy_object_id (null allowed only for non-response claims); each variant_id has one claim owner. A variant's evidence_ids list all evidence admitted to its coherent interpretation, including compatible delivery details. Detail citations must be a subset. Claim lower=min(variant bands); upper=max(variant bands). Show the lower label and Details vary when qualification differs. Never assemble criteria across incompatible variants.
claims.conditionality: An attributable conditional policy commitment qualifies as a response; show its conditions separately, without extra points or penalties
claims.reported_result: A reported effect alone does not prove an attributable policy response or causation; a separate qualifying response assertion is required
claims.value_conflicts: Conflicting numbers do not reduce a band when qualification is unchanged; retain both values and the conflict badge
claims.display: Claim band codes are internal diagnostics only. Show statement type, delivery checks, conditions, source and reported stage; no headline claim score.

topics.lower: max(claim lower bands), or internal 0 if no claim
topics.upper: max(claim upper bands) when processing_complete; otherwise 3
topics.display: Show demonstrated lower label plus Details vary / Search incomplete as applicable. If no evidence and processing is incomplete, band=null and label=Unavailable; internal [0,3] is only an uncertainty bound.
topics.completeness_contract: Normalized scope.source_profile_complete is required. Input topic.processing_complete describes supplied-job completion. Effective assessment processing_complete = supplied-job completion AND required source-profile completeness. Preserve job_processing_complete separately. Missing required roles force unknown unproved predicates while retaining positive evidence; do not turn a missing NAP into zeros.
topics.secondary_topics: Multi-topic normalized claims require explicit topic_projections for every topic, with independently source-checked statement type and retained/subset delivery details per canonical variant. Predicates are computed from each projection, never inherited from tags. Projections cannot invent new evidence, response stages, policy identities or stronger delivery details. Single-topic inputs remain lean. A topic displayed in multiple domains is still one topic.
topics.limitation: One detailed response can establish band 3. Show response-claim and detail-ready-claim counts; the band does not assess comprehensiveness of the policy portfolio.

domains.denominator: Fixed unique home-topic IDs in the common comparison profile; filters and duplicate display placements do not change N
domains.P: Number of topics whose demonstrated lower band is at least 2
domains.A: Number of complete topics whose upper band is below 2
domains.U: N - P - A; response status remains undetermined
domains.response_coverage: 100 * P / N when U=0; otherwise [100 * P / N, 100 * (P+U) / N]
domains.distributions: Count demonstrated topic bands 0,1,2,3 and unavailable separately. Mark ranges/incomplete topics; never present provisional counts as final.
domains.availability: Show processing_complete topics / N independently from response coverage. Positive evidence can remain in P even when another source fails.
domains.national_inventory: Sum positive unique topics / all unique profile topics, calculated separately for each metric; never average domain percentages. This describes documentation inventory, not effort, adequacy or a national policy-quality score.

coverage_metrics.uncertainty: For each predicate separately: claim lower=all coherent variants qualify; upper=any qualify. Topic lower=any claim lower; upper=any claim upper or processing incomplete. P=demonstrated, A=definitely not found, U=undetermined. Coverage bounds are 100*P/N and 100*(P+U)/N.
coverage_metrics.independence: Delivery details and implementation reporting each imply a response, but neither implies the other. Never blend the three percentages.
coverage_metrics.display: Percentages always show numerator and fixed denominator. Topic color remains the four-band rubric; no new good/bad thresholds for domain or country percentages.

stages.rule: Show each source assertion's stage. Current status requires explicit update lineage. Never infer replacement from publication date, average stages, or copy later stages into historical document views.

require: same defined document-role and date coverage
comparison.provisional: All-document exploration stays available; incompatible/incomplete source profiles are labelled provisional and excluded from complete regional comparisons
comparison.regional_view: Show topic bands and separate response/delivery-detail percentages with fixed counts and source completeness. The 64-topic default is an inventory, not 64 universal policy obligations.
comparison.not_applicable: Never infer N/A from silence or simple geography, and never remove difficult topics automatically. A future narrower regional core is a versioned configuration shared by all countries in that cohort.
comparison.priority_lens: Highlight only source-stated priorities with citations. Country priorities can filter/sort the view but do not change the common benchmark denominator or weights.

supplied_all.selection: All explicitly selected supplied documents, with exact source IDs retained

ndc_only.selection: Latest eligible NDC edition within each agreed family as of the cutoff

ndc_nap.purpose: Matched NDC and NAP documentation comparison
ndc_nap.selection: Latest eligible edition for each required role/family as of the cutoff

source_selection_rules: Profiles select a comparison corpus; they never establish policy supersession, withdrawal or replacement.

Missing required role sets source_profile_complete=false. Affected topic processing is incomplete; retain demonstrated positives and unknown upper bounds. Never automatically substitute another document role.
Store exact selected source IDs, family IDs, roles, source edition dates, cutoff date and ingestion timestamps separately.
Historical editions remain in history outside the current comparison corpus. Carry-forward requires explicit evidence and provenance, not silent reuse.
A permitted functional equivalent needs an explicit versioned profile rule. Missing NAP material cannot silently become NDC evidence of complete adaptation coverage.
DRR-topic silence in an NDC/NAP corpus means not found in that corpus, not weak national disaster policy. A DRR comparison requires an explicitly shared source-role profile.

change_arrows.meaning: Change in documented coverage, never proof of policy effectiveness or real-world implementation progress
requirements: same source-role/family coverage and date rule
newer eligible source edition under the same family
both snapshots recomputed on the same method
change_arrows.partial_default: Suppress arrow and point delta; show source/processing limitations
change_arrows.specialist_interval: Optional possible delta [new lower-old upper, new upper-old lower], always labelled documentation uncertainty; no point arrow for partial snapshots
change_arrows.color: Neutral direction icons for increases and decreases; never green/red climate-performance claims
change_arrows.absence: A missing restatement in a later corpus is not an inferred withdrawal. Explicit source-backed withdrawals are retained as annotations.

automatic_checks.reference_engine: Consumes already source-checked normalized assessments and evidence IDs. It checks IDs, enums, field presence, unique variant ownership, coherent evidence membership and policy-object references; it cannot prove semantic truth, exhaustive search, source fidelity or the raw record ownership partition itself.
automatic_checks.invalid_input: The strict calculator rejects invalid contracts. The safe adapter returns unavailable with no assessment; never replace a rejected assessment with a zero or an empty successful result.
automatic_checks.post_publication: Flag/hide is a presentation overlay by default. Analytical exclusions create a separately labelled adjusted snapshot.
